records.en: Used to upgrade Fellow Aptitude Skills.
Aptitude +4. An axe owned by every household.
Aptitude +6. A lantern using white phosphorus.
◆ The Explore function will automatically stop when the player has run out of Gold, when Fellows don't have enough Power to clear a stage, when the event list is full, or when you exit the game.
◆ Family members can improve the strength of specified Fellows through Blessing Skills.
◆ These are Fellows' natural abilities. Their effects can be improved through Awakening.
◆ Some rare Fellows possess aura abilities that can improve Fellow Power by a percentage.
◆ This increases the level limit of a Fellow.
◆ An important way to improve the Power of rare Fellows, it can also improve their Talent levels.
◆ The level of Fellows can be improved by spending Fellow EXP.
◆ Fellows are divided into five different types: Inspiring, Diligent, Brave, Informed, and Unfettered. Some Fellows also have talents that increase the Power of Fellows of the same type.
◆ Aptitude determines the training potential of Fellows. The rarer a Fellow is, the higher their initial Aptitude will be.
◆ Skills improve the effect of Fellows' various attributes. Upgrade skills by consuming Skill Scrolls and other materials.
